title: A Sales Funnel for a Solo Coach
description: A step-by-step setup plan that connected a coach's posts, emails, and offers, on the platform she already paid for.
seoTitle: A Sales Funnel for a Solo Coach
problem: The coach had finished courses, a mailing list, and an audience, but nothing connected them.
Her main button led to a call about long-term coaching, with no way to buy a single session.
solution: Planned a path from posts and events to a free practice, welcome emails, a single paid session, and ongoing coaching, with courses as a separate option.
Sent 15 setup steps for the platform she already paid for. She did the setup herself with an AI assistant.
result: A week later her courses were on sale and the single session was open for booking.
heroAlt: Sales funnel: weekly Instagram and TikTok teaching posts and event QR codes lead to a free practice and email signup, then welcome emails and a monthly letter. The main invitation is a single paid session, followed by ongoing coaching. The emails and the Instagram and TikTok bio link also lead to self-paced courses. Weekly LinkedIn posts link straight to the paid session.
